messages:
maria: Heads-up: rolling out coordinated change touching router, runtime, and console during 00:00-02:00 UTC change window. 3-wave rollout with kernel pin on runtime.
sean: Need exact artifacts to put in the rollout doc — which tags and kernels?
maria: router -> router:v2.1.0, runtime -> runtime:2026-03-kernelA, console -> console:3.4.1. I'll add commands below.
katie: Note: console schema flag 'console-toggle' will be flipped in wave 2. UI smoke required after flip.
maria: Wave plan: wave1=1%, wave2=25% (schema flip), wave3=100%. Gate per-wave: 20m with no critical alerts.
sean: Proposed auto-rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >150ms sustained for 10m OR error rate >0.8% for 5m.
infra-shephard: Add immediate rollback on any JVM OOM or runtime GPU OOM. Also watch KV cache miss rate; set alert on 3x baseline for 10m.
maria: Good catch — KV-miss >3x for 10m added. Manual hold always available.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduling wave 1 at 2026-03-25T00:10:00Z. Commands queued:
```
# pin router and reserve runtime pool
deploybot pin --service router --version router:v2.1.0 --window 00:00-02:00
deploybot reserve --service runtime --kernel kernelA --capacity 50
```

katie: I'll own UI smoke for waves 1 and 2.
sean: I'll bump trace sampling to 100% for first 5m of each wave and monitor traces.
maria: I'll handle traffic shift. @infra-shephard watch infra alarms and open rollback channel if needed.
infra-shephard: Oncall confirmed. Will post alerts to #incidents.
dev-ex-bot: DevEx: added release notes and pin walkthrough: https://redwood.devex/release-notes/2026-03-25-sequenced-rollout
maria: Preflight checklist before wave1: deploybot pins applied, runtime pool reserved, tracing enabled, canary GA test.
katie: UI smoke list: login, embedding flow, settings page.
sean: Ops thresholds snippet for runbook: p95>150ms @10m, error_rate>0.8% @5m, OOM detected -> immediate rollback.

deploybot: deploybot: wave 1 executed at 2026-03-25T00:10:12Z. Canary instances: 12. Pins confirmed.
katie: Wave1 UI smoke done. No console errors.
sean: Traces stable, p95 unchanged, error_rate 0.05%.
infra-shephard: Infra healthy. KV miss +10% transient for ~2m then normalized.
maria: Scheduling wave2 (schema flip) at ~2026-03-25T00:40:00Z. If any gate trips we stop and rollback to router:v2.0.8 and unpin kernel.
sean: Acknowledged. Leaving elevated sampling for wave2.
katie: Ready for schema flip watch.
maria: If anything fuzzy, hit :rotating_light: and we stop traffic shift. Otherwise final wave later in window.
sean: 👍
katie: :thumbsup:
